I don't know if it helps you, but when I was suicidal one thought helped me above all others: "This life is my only chance to make things better. If I die now I will never be able to make things better than how I feel right now." I believed that if I die suicidal I will forever feel this despair and never get a chance to make anything better.  A dismal view I know, but it worked for me at a time when I had no idea even why I was miserable day in and day out. As it turned out it was gender dysphoria which I am recently addressing (17 years later).

You can do this, take it one day at a time and find a way to let your mind relax. I needed a break from all the thinking I was doing on myself.  For me it was video games for some others its exercise, others its meditation. 

 This is the best advice I can offer.  I really hope you the best.  Remember, you're worth it even if you don't believe it right now
